name: Homelands
description: Adds Homelands as an independently enabled expansion: 115 distinct cards across 140 published printings. Its stone medallion lives under Deck Builder Extras, leaving the original set strip unchanged.
rules_note: No other numbered pack is required. The game ships trusted executable card rules; this ZIP supplies checked metadata and artwork only. Ante cards follow the game's ante setting. Digital adaptation: Timmerian Fiends ownership exchanges exclude tokens. See Help and docs/simplified-cards.md.
